name: name-hold-off
breaks: for 30 days after an app's term ends only its last owner may register its name

edits.from: if (clock.tipBlockTime - ended < NAME_HOLD_SECONDS) return refused(entry, name, 'name-reserved');

lists the app again with its identity and its content when its last owner renews it within 30 days

name: name-held-forever
breaks: the name hold ends 30 days after the term

edits.from: if (clock.tipBlockTime - ended < NAME_HOLD_SECONDS) return refused(entry, name, 'name-reserved');

name: no-renewal-of-an-expired-app
breaks: an update to an app no longer listed is judged against the state it last held
